posts.name: dclietz
posts.cooked:
MindWanderer:

  1. The first time you were given free reign to tackle OblivAeon with a team/setup of your choice, how did you go about it?

  2. Any tips for getting the most fun out of this scenario?

As another playtester, I'd say:

  1. I did everything random, with H=4. But a ny team can work, some lower tier heroes are excellent in this format because they are better at beating missions and using rewards (Bunker is really good ) . J ust don't plan on your initial team surviving. H=3 is tough, I'd suggest starting out with H=4 or H=5.

  2. Focus on beating some missions against form 1.  It is OK if your first hero goes down, your next hero just needs to come back with a vengeance! Also getting awesome mission rewards is super fun.

posts.cooked: Takewalker - Since as we all know, The Box is designed to hold all the cards sleeved. I imagine sleeving a card probably doubles its thickness, or thereabouts (depending on the thickness of the sleeves being used, I suppose). Since I don't sleeve my cards I should logically therefore only use half or maybe three quarters of the space in the box, which hopefully will be space enough to fit the Cauldron decks. What I will need at that point will be some dividers to separate said Cauldron decks, since right now they're in individual little plastic bag thingys in a separate cardboard box. But I can figure that out when I get there :P.
